title: Khalid's Gift
summary: Wear for +1 Wisdom up to 21 and self-only Aid. Jaheira also gains curse immunity.

fields.Wisdom: +1 Wisdom, with a hard cap of 21. The bonus does not apply if it would take you above that cap.
fields.Odd Gift: Only Jaheira gains immunity to the Cursed status group. Equipping the amulet also immediately removes her existing curses.
fields.Aid: Action, self only, once per Long Rest. The level 3 spell heals you for 10 HP and raises your maximum HP by 10 until Long Rest.
fields.Acquisition: Display case in the basement of Elerrathin’s Home, X −1572, Y 976. The bookcase access can be opened with DC 18 Sleight of Hand. It is present regardless of Jaheira’s recruitment or survival.
fields.Base value: 140 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
